dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply falcate trailing edge characterized by a concave spline fitting between the posterior insertion point and the apex, interrupted by multiple irregular notches.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a narrow pixel radius at the maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin rising at approximately a 55-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1 ratio of maximum basal width to vertical height from the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three distinct, jagged V-shaped notches are present on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin. A faint, linear horizontal scar is visible near the base of the fin, and multiple small, light-colored circular lesions/spots are scattered across the lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Subtle, diffuse light-gray pigmentation patch visible on the lower-middle section of the dorsal fin's lateral flank.
